DiastaticPowerType.description: Diastatic power is a measurement of malted grains enzymatic content. A value of 35 Lintner is needed to self convert, while a value of 100 or more is desirable for base malts.

ColorType.description: ColorType supports both grain color properties, such as Lovibond, and wort color properties such as SRM and EBC.

GravityType.description: Gravity refers to the both the measurements of percent of sugar content, ie plato and brix, as well as relative density ie specific gravity.

SpecificHeatType.description: Specific heat is the measurement of the amount of heat required to raise a given mass one degree..

ConcentrationType.description: Examples for concentration include ppm, ppb, and mg/l.

SpecificVolumeType.description: Specific volume is the inverse of density, with units of volume over mass, ie qt/lb or L/kg. Commonly used for mash thickness.

UnitType.description: UnitType is used where unitless amounts are required, such as 1 apple, or 1 yeast packet.
